summary: Iteration 5 — Membership upgrade/plan-change vs renewal fix VERIFIED. BACKEND: new /app/backend/tests/test_membership_upgrade.py 7/7 PASSED (public URL). Fresh candidate Quarterly→Half-Yearly→Annual gives expiry today+90 → today+180 (not 270) → today+365 (not ~2y); previous subs marked status 'upgraded' with upgraded_to; new sub is_upgrade=true, upgraded_from set, is_renewal=false. Annual again (same plan) = renewal → prev expiry+365, is_renewal=true, old annual sub stays 'active'. 4 payments (599/799/999/999) recorded & linked to subscriptions. GET /admin/subscriptions (incl. ?status=upgraded filter, effective_status='upgraded'), /admin/payments, /admin/candidates/{id}, /admin/dashboard all 200. /career/usage after Quarterly→Annual: tier=annual, limits 40, used counted from new purchase (2 seeded quarterly uses → 0). Edge cases: downgrade Annual→Quarterly → today+90; expired then buy → today+90 (not renewal); expiring_soon (7d) same-plan renewal → 7+180=187d. Dev panel: activate_90 → simulate_renewal (stack 180) → activate_90 (stack 270) → activate_365 (replace 365) → simulate_renewal (730) → reset_account all OK. Regression test_jobradar.py 27/27 PASSED after updating stale 499/699 price asserts to 599/799. FRONTEND (390x844): /plans as active member shows plan-change-note: same plan → 'Renewal: N days will be added after your current expiry (YYYY-MM-DD).', different plan → 'Plan change: your X will be replaced. The Y starts today and is valid for N days.'; demo checkout navigates to /membership with correct expiry (Quarterly→Annual: Expires 29 Oct 2027, 364 days; Annual→Half: 27 Apr 2027; Half renewal: 24 Oct 2027, 359 days). Membership cache refreshed correctly after checkout (note reflects new plan on return). No deprecated Expo packages found.

minor.issue: Plan change discards remaining days with no credit/proration. Downgrade Annual (e.g. 300 days left) → Quarterly gives only today+90; upgrade Quarterly with 85 days left → Half-Yearly gives 180 from today. Per spec this is intended, but downgrades silently lose paid time — consider blocking downgrade while active, or crediting/queuing remaining days.

Usage window starts from latest subscription created_at, so a same-plan renewal while active resets used counts to 0 (fresh 40/25/15 immediately, even though prior plan period has not ended). Confirm this is desired.

issues: plan-change-note is rendered at the top of the ScrollView; when user scrolls down to select Half-Yearly/Annual the note is off-screen (bbox y=-286), so the 'your plan will be replaced' warning is not visible at the moment they tap Continue to Payment. Suggest showing the note in/above the bottom bar near checkout-btn or a confirm dialog for plan change/downgrade.

Default selected plan for an active member is the featured Quarterly plan, not their current plan — e.g. Half-Yearly member opens /plans and immediately sees a 'Plan change ... Quarterly' (downgrade) note. Consider preselecting the current plan.
Note/demo banner text #D97706 on #FEF3C7 at 13px ≈ 2.9:1 contrast (below WCAG 4.5:1). Use a darker amber (e.g. #92400E).

action_items: Optional UX: move/duplicate plan-change-note near the checkout button (or confirm dialog) so the replacement warning is visible when tapping Continue to Payment
Optional UX: preselect the member's current plan on /plans
Product decision: handle downgrade while active (block, warn strongly, or credit remaining days)
Optional: improve contrast of amber banner text
